AccessEvent.description: One entry of a memory's access history.

AdminStatus.description: `GET /v1/admin/status`. On a local install the server-only parts are `null`.

containers.description: `{ claimed, ready, starting }` on a server.

ApiKey.description: An API key, without its secret.

BatchItemResult_StoredMemory.description: One entry of a batch result, in request order.

oneOf.description: Why it was refused.

memory.description:
The answer of a save. `links` are the edges made for the memory, for the host's live
event; they are not serialized.

oneOf.description: Set by the host when the duplicate check could not run.

embedding.description: `pending`, or `ready` when a vector came with the save.

oneOf.description: Near duplicates, when asked for and found.

strength.description: Raw strength now: 1.0 unless an earlier `createdAt` was sent.

oneOf.description: On a supersede: the replaced memory.

BatchResult_StoredMemory.description: The answer of a batch save.

results.description: One entry per item, in order.

Code.description: The 17 error codes. This list is closed; the SDK mirrors it.

CompactHit.description: One compact recall or context hit.

date.description: UTC date with weekday, for example `Fri 2023-01-20`.

fullText.description: For the top hits that still have it.

oneOf.description: `model_unavailable` when the query had no vector.

ContainerView.description: `{ state, since }` of a user's container.

webUrl.description: Where people browse the store, or `null`.

ContextResult.description: The engine's part of the context answer. The host adds `model` and `webUrl` ([`Context`]).

oneOf.description: Only when a topic could not be embedded.

embedding.description: The embedding queue of the store.

name.description: 1 to 64 bytes of ASCII letters, digits, `-` and `_`.

CreatedApiKey.description: A new key and its secret, which only this answer carries.

Degraded.description: Why a recall has no vector channel.

DuplicateCheck.description: Why the duplicate check did not run although it was asked for.

EdgeType.description: The type of a directed edge. The numbers match recalld; 3 and 4 do not exist here.

EmbeddingProgress.description: `{ pending, total }` of the embedding queue.

total.description: Every memory that is not a ghost.

EmbeddingState.description: Whether a memory has a vector.

docsUrl.description: Only on `store_locked` from `GET /v1/session` on a locked local install.

field.description: Present only when one request field is at fault.

reason.description: A fixed word, where the code has one (`store_locked`, `permission_denied`, `unavailable`).

ErrorCode.description: The error codes the engine can cause, a subset of the API's closed list.

Explanation.description: Why a hit ranked where it did; only for `GET /v1/ui/search`.

activation.description: Activation, for a hit the graph found.

hops.description: Hops, for a hit the graph found.

oneOf.description: The superseded memory this hit stands in for.

text.description: Full-text score as a candidate, or `null`.

oneOf.description: The memory whose spread into this hit was the largest.
That edge's type.

recordAccess.description: The host records the hits as `associative` afterwards.

ForgetItem.description: One entry of a batch forget, in request order.

deleted.description: Removed (or, on a dry run, exists).

ForgetManyResult.description: The answer of a batch forget.

deleted.description: How many were removed (or, on a dry run, exist).

dryRun.description: Report which IDs exist and remove nothing.

Forgotten.description: The answer of a forget. `deleted` is false when no such memory exists.

id.description: The ID that was asked for.

oneOf.description: Only when the host asked for it.

related.description: Edges to other hits on the page.

FullHit.description: One full recall hit: the memory view plus `score`, `related` and, for the UI, `explanation`.

oneOf.description: `model_unavailable` when the query had no vector.

ImportError.description: One error line of an import.

ItemError.description: The error of one batch item.

Items_ApiKey.description: A list that is not paged.

items.description: An API key, without its secret.

Items_Namespace.description: A list that is not paged.

items.description: A namespace as the API shows it (schema `Namespace`).

memoryCount.description: Memories in every phase, ghosts included.

oneOf.description: On a policy dry run: what the next sweep would move under the new policy.

Items_SimilarHit.description: A list that is not paged.

Items_Store.description: A list that is not paged.

items.description: An account-level store record, not its memories.

LockReason.description: Why a store cannot be opened: the `reason` of `store_locked`.

Memory.description:
The full view of a memory (schema `Memory`). `summary` is absent for a ghost;
`fullText` is absent when there is none or the route leaves it out.

accessHistory.description: Oldest first; only where a route asks for it.

client.description: The MCP client that saved it.

edgeCount.description: Edges stored for the memory, of every type, whatever is at the other end.

fullText.description: The long text, where the route includes it.

oneOf.description: Last reinforcement.
Last recorded access.

summary.description: The short text; absent for a ghost.

MemoryId.description: Identity of one memory. UUIDv7, so the natural order is creation order.

ModelState.description: The model state of the process that serves the store (schema `ModelState`).

oneOf.description: Why it is unavailable.

ModelStatus.description: The state of the embedding model.

MoveMemories.description: `POST /v1/memories/move`: 1 to 100 unique IDs, all or nothing.

sourceNamespace.description: A check only: every ID must be in it. Never filled in.

Namespace.description: A namespace as the API shows it (schema `Namespace`).

memoryCount.description: Memories in every phase, ghosts included.

oneOf.description: On a policy dry run: what the next sweep would move under the new policy.

NamespaceCount.description: One namespace with its memory count.

NamespaceDeleted.description: The answer of a namespace delete.

NamespacePolicy.description:
A namespace's decay policy. Also the `policy` object of the API, where all five
keys are required and `decayRateMultiplier` may be `null`.

decayRateMultiplier.description: At least 0. `None` means 1.0; 0 turns decay off.

defaultDifficulty.description: Difficulty of a new memory, 1 to 10.

initialStability.description: Stability of a new memory, 0.01 to 36,500 days.

permastoreThreshold.description: Stability, in days, from which a memory is permanent. Greater than 0.

averageStrength.description: Mean strength now of the memories that are not ghosts; 0 when there are none.

edgeCount.description: Edges whose two ends are both in the namespace.

oneOf.description: Newest `createdAt`.
Oldest `createdAt`.

textBytes.description: Bytes of every summary and full text.

NearDuplicate.description: One existing memory that closely resembles a new one.

summary.description: Its summary, cut to 240 bytes with `…`.

NearDuplicates.description: The near-duplicate advice of a save. Absent when nothing matches.

Page_Memory.description: A page of a list (`nextCursor` is `null` on the last page).

items.description:
The full view of a memory (schema `Memory`). `summary` is absent for a ghost;
`fullText` is absent when there is none or the route leaves it out.

accessHistory.description: Oldest first; only where a route asks for it.

client.description: The MCP client that saved it.

edgeCount.description: Edges stored for the memory, of every type, whatever is at the other end.

fullText.description: The long text, where the route includes it.

oneOf.description: Last reinforcement.
Last recorded access.

summary.description: The short text; absent for a ghost.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page.

Page_TagCount.description: A page of a list (`nextCursor` is `null` on the last page).

items.description: One tag with the number of memories that carry it.

count.description: Memories in the namespace that carry it.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page.

Page_User.description: A page of a list (`nextCursor` is `null` on the last page).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page.

Phase.description: How much content a memory has left. It only moves down: Full, Summary, Ghost.

PhaseThresholds.description: The three phase thresholds: `0 < ghost_to_delete < summary_to_ghost < full_to_summary < 1`.

fullToSummary.description: Effective strength at or below which the full text fades.

ghostToDelete.description: Raw strength at or below which a ghost is deleted.

summaryToGhost.description: Effective strength at or below which the memory becomes a ghost.

Provider.description: The identity provider, when sign-in is on.

entities.description: All must match (lower-cased whole strings); also feeds scoring and the entity channel.

fullTextCount.description: 0 to `limit`. Its default depends on `limit`; see [`Recall::full_text_count`].

query.description: Not empty after trimming; at most 4,096 bytes.

recordAccess.description: The host records access afterwards; always false without `memory:write`.

tags.description: All must match; each a valid tag.

oneOf.description: Give both bounds or neither.
Give both bounds or neither. A boost, not a filter.
`detail: compact`.
`detail: full`.

RecallResponse.description: The recall answer in the shape `detail` asked for.

isPermastore.description: Set once stability reached the threshold.

Related.description: An edge between a hit and another hit on the same page.

RotateApiKey.description: The optional body of a rotation.

signedOutReason.description: `expired`, `account_removed` or `not_allowed`, when a credential was refused.

SessionCredential.description: The credential of a session answer.

SessionUser.description: The user of a session answer.

Store.description: An account-level store record, not its memories.

StoreMemories.description: Body of `POST /v1/memories/batch`: 1 to 100 items, each with its own namespace.

StoreMemory.description: Body of `POST /v1/memories`; the `store_memory` tool converts into it.

oneOf.description: An earlier creation time, for imports and the benchmark.

namespace.description: Filled in by the host from the header or `default` before hashing.

oneOf.description: A memory in the same namespace that becomes the parent.
An earlier creation time.

namespace.description: Filled in by the host before hashing.

oneOf.description: A memory in the same namespace that becomes the parent.

StoredMemory.description:
The answer of a save. `links` are the edges made for the memory, for the host's live
event; they are not serialized.

oneOf.description: Set by the host when the duplicate check could not run.

embedding.description: `pending`, or `ready` when a vector came with the save.

oneOf.description: Near duplicates, when asked for and found.

strength.description: Raw strength now: 1.0 unless an earlier `createdAt` was sent.

oneOf.description: On a supersede: the replaced memory.

SupersedeMemory.description: `POST /v1/memories/{id}/supersede`: a new memory in the old one's namespace.

checkDuplicates.description: Report near duplicates, leaving the replaced memory out.

oneOf.description: An earlier creation time.

Tag.description:
A tag: lower-cased, 1 to 128 bytes, starting with an ASCII letter or digit,
and using only `a-z 0-9 / _ . : -`.

TagCount.description: One tag with the number of memories that carry it.

count.description: Memories in the namespace that carry it.

oneOf.description: Milliseconds since 1970.

TimeValue.description: A time-range bound: an RFC 3339 string or whole milliseconds.

WouldChange.description: What the next sweep would move under a new policy.
